messages:
marta-fin: Heads up — ACME invoice 86421 shows a $15,000 promo credit applied to their $120k prepaid commit for 2026. Promo effective 2026-03-12 per change order. How should we treat this for March close: defer across term or take as immediate contra?

leo-ops: Need contract amendment date to confirm effective period. Do we have signed change order?

anna-sales: Change order signed 2026-03-10, customer requested promo to start 3/12. Service term still runs through 2026-12-31.

marta-fin: ok. context: original prepaid recognized monthly in unearned revenue. Promo reduced invoice cash by 15k. thinking allocation over remaining service period vs immediate reduction. materiality?

devin-rev: Under ASC 606, discount that is related to future performance should be allocated over the remaining performance obligation. So allocate the $15k across Mar126DDec126 (10 months). Monthly amort = 1,500.

marta-fin: can you draft JEs and description for the monthclose package? we need to tag for review and note tax implications.

devin-rev: Drafting now. Proposed postings:

Dr Cash (net invoice) 105,000  
Dr Promo Expense/Contra-receivable ??? (depending on subledger) 15,000 
  Cr Unearned Revenue (liability) 120,000  <-- original cash + promo line recorded on billing date

Then amortization approach (monthly):
Dr Contract Liability - Promo 1,500
  Cr Revenue 1,500

Alternatively, reduce Unearned Revenue directly by 15,000 and amortize the reduced liability. Either approach ok; require audit note.

leo-ops: For GL tagging: please use revenue_schedule tag RS-ACME-86421-PROMO. I'll attach the allocation to the revenue schedule table. close-bot, can you run a revenue schedule recalculation for that invoice?

close-bot: Revenue schedule recalculation queued for invoice/86421. ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anna-sales: tax team: invoice was taxed on net ($105k). If we allocate promo across time, tax returns may need adjustment depending on jurisdiction. @tax-ops please advise.

tax-ops: on it. FYI many jurisdictions tax on invoiced amount at billing time. If we give the promo as a discount on consideration, tax was already collected on net; might need local adjustments. We'll confirm and flag if any VAT/Sales tax remittance changes required.

marta-fin: thanks. For the monthclose memo I'll state: "Promo considered an allocated consideration adjustment.", amortization over remaining performance period (10 months), monthly recognition = $1,500. Attach signed change order and revenue schedule.

devin-rev: I'll add the allocation table and sample month JE to the close pack. Also include alternative entry if finance prefers to net against unearned revenue.

leo-ops: Quick Q: promo effective 3/12, do we do partial month in March? Our policy usually full-month for subscription commits unless > material threshold. This is $1.5k/month, immaterial. Recommend full-month amortization for simplicity.

marta-fin: agree. treat March as full-month. we'll document judgment and materiality threshold in the memo.

close-bot: Revenue schedule recalculation completed for invoice/86421. Changes: uneared_revenue reduced by 15,000; 10-month amort schedule created (RS-ACME-86421-PROMO).

marta-fin: great, thanks. I'll post the JE for review in the close-doc and tag finance-lead. Approver: @devin-rev please sign off once attached.

devin-rev: reviewing now. will sign after tax confirms if any adjustment rows required.

marta-fin: done — JE uploaded to monthclose/2026-03 with note: "ACME promo allocated over remaining contract term per ASC 606; full-month amortization applied for March due to immateriality; tax team notified." Closing this thread unless issues. :white_check_mark:
